msg_content.problem_statement: Create a simple website where users can log in and see an album of images. Use this explicit MVP contract and do not ask clarifying questions unless something here is internally contradictory: build a runnable local full-stack web app, not a mockup; use a simple server-rendered Python Flask app with SQLite; use a preconfigured demo account username `demo` and password `demo123`; no registration flow; no image upload flow; show a predefined gallery of placeholder/sample images after login; this is for local development only, not deployment hardening; basic clean styling is sufficient; build the app entirely inside `{{TEST_OUTPUT_DIR}}` and treat that directory as the project root for all generated files; return the implementation result as a final Task response.
